newsitem.title: UK: Stolt Comex wins $15 mln Irish deal.
newsitem.headline: Stolt Comex wins $15 mln Irish deal.

text.p: Stolt Comex Seaway S.A. said Tuesday its consortium had won a $15-million contract for the installation works on the Statoil Connemara field development to the west of Ireland.
It said the SCS/McDermott E.T.P.M. West Inc consortium would install the deep water field development in two parts.

It would first install production and umbilical risers for an extended well test in May 1997, then install a mooring system, flexible flowlines, risers and a well control umbilical in March 1998, it said.
Stolt Comex Seaway, a subsea contractor to the oil and gas industry, said it would do all of the work.
